### The Faith of Ordinary People
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/the-faith-of-ordinary-people-bible-study-minute-january-22-2018.html
Passage: Hebrews 11:31
Points:
- God looks past social labels and often uses unlikely people to accomplish His plans.
- Rahab showed true faith by risking her life to protect the Israelite spies.
- Hearing of God's mighty acts produced a reverent fear that moved her to action.
- Believers are called to let holy reverence motivate active obedience and service.

### Receiving the Promise
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/receiving-promise
Passage: Hebrews 11:39-40
Points:
- Old covenant believers persevered in faith even though they did not receive the final promise during their lives.
- Returning to former ritual shadows would actually abandon the hope those saints waited for.
- God provided something better by inaugurating the age of perfection in Jesus Christ.
- Modern believers must cling to Christ through suffering, standing united with the saints of old.
